Neeko|sup.identity: Control and ambush mage. Inherent Glamour (passive): she can take the appearance of an allied champion or other units; the disguise ends when she casts an offensive ability, takes CC or too much damage. Blooming Burst (Q) throws a seed that blooms again if it hits a champion or kills an enemy, Shapesplitter (W) passively empowers every third attack and, when activated, sends out a clone, Tangle-Barbs (E) roots every enemy it passes through (longer after passing through a champion), and Pop Blossom (R) makes her leap to knock up, then stun enemies around her (the windup is invisible while she's disguised).
Neeko|sup.playstyle: Control and surprise support: she roots from range with E and engages in disguise with her ultimate. She beats fragile or slow supports (Xerath, Pyke, Swain) but struggles against enchanters who cancel her engage (Janna, Milio, Zilean).
Neeko|sup.early_game: Poke with Blooming Burst (Q) on your opponent when they come to last hit. Look for Tangle-Barbs (E) through a minion or champion: it grows and roots longer. Disguise yourself as a minion or ally to surprise your opponent.
Neeko|sup.level_1: Blooming Burst (Q) first. After that, max Q first.
Neeko|sup.level_2: Tangle-Barbs (E). Combo: E through your opponent, then Q on the rooted target.
Neeko|sup.level_3: Shapesplitter (W). Speed and damage on every third attack; the clone fools your opponent or helps you escape.
Neeko|sup.level_6: Pop Blossom: disguised, approach the enemy group (as an ally, for example), then R: the windup can't be seen. Chain E and Q on stunned enemies.
power_spikes: First completed item: poke and burst.
Neeko|sup.lane_plan: Poke with Q, look for CC with E and surprise your opponent in disguise. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored).
Neeko|sup.trading: Basic trade: Q. All-in: E → Q → attacks → R. Defense: E on the diver, clone to escape. Against enchanters who heal and disengage (Janna, Milio), play for poke rather than engage.
threats: Janna, Zilean and Milio: hard matchups.
Engage supports who dive you: you're fragile.
mistakes: Casting an offensive ability too early and breaking your disguise.
Casting E with no minion or champion to pass through.
Casting your ultimate in plain sight in the middle of the enemy team with no follow-up.

matchup_notes.Thresh: Stay behind minions for his hook, and E him when he steps up.
matchup_notes.Lulu: Her polymorph cuts off your ultimate: engage once she's used it.
matchup_notes.Karma: She pokes you: play for CC rather than trades.
matchup_notes.Xerath: He has no mobility: your E punishes him.
matchup_notes.Janna: Her tornado and ultimate cancel your engage: wait until she's used them.

Neeko|sup.mid_game: Disguise yourself to roam and surprise isolated enemies. Place Control Wards around objectives.
Neeko|sup.late_game: Approach the enemy group in disguise, then ultimate in the middle. E to root divers on your ADC.
Neeko|sup.ahead: Look for surprise engages and picks.
Neeko|sup.behind: Poke from range and keep E to protect your ADC.
Neeko|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to surprise the enemy team with your disguised ultimate and chain your CC.
Neeko|sup.final_tip: While disguised, your ultimate's windup can't be seen: it's your best engage.
